interpret_yaw_pitch: parse a yaw pitch string and return head yaw pitch tuple for the agent
interpret_yaw: interpret a yaw direction from a word or number and return head yaw pitch
interpret_pitch: interpret a pitch direction from a word or number and return head yaw pitch
interpret_relative_pitch: interpret relative pitch directions like up or down with optional degree values
interpret_facing_location: interpret a location reference and return head xyz coordinates for the agent to face
